notes: Written from the guide's 'Game plan by turn' and 'Playbook seeds'.

Every number here is an inference (review M5a-09): the guide gives the direction, not the value. weights, faceBias, counterAggression, cardValue and bias sizes were set by reasoning and have not been tuned on their own.

Bias sizes were chosen so the planted game-plan tests pass; ai/test/game-plan-g2.test.ts runs every seed with the biases off too, and lists the seeds that pass only because a bias encodes the guide's line.
Citations ('cite', 'citeSource') are what 'Why?' shows when a move follows the line; only biases whose condition is public carry one.
goFirst false: the guide's Mulligan section gives the T3 combo odds as higher going second (94% vs 88%) and the sixth DON!! pays for ST30-012's Rush [SH-LA].
faceBias 1.05/1.1/1.1: 'a red/green Straw Hat aggro deck' [SH-LA]; inference: slightly more weight on the opponent's Life.
cardValue: the guide's 'keep the Luffys on board, since at 9000 on defence they make the opponent spend real resources to clear them' [SH-LA]; Thousand Sunny's DON!! giving.
mulligan: the guide's keepable hand (inference): a searcher or Thousand Sunny plus Sanji or a Luffy, or two searchers. Sanji counts as a searcher for the first piece (the guide: take Sanji first).
seed 4 never triggers in the sourced lists (no Character has 7000 base power); the bias keeps it that way if a flex card does.

seeds 5 and 6: the guide's own reading of the two Events' [Main] modes (card text, inference). Both are penalties on a [Main] play when the condition is false, so the Event is kept for its Counter use.
